methods.what: Phase of the combined sinusoid: the sum of two sine terms with amplitudes a, b and phases A, B written as a single sine with phase arctan((a sin A + b sin B)/(a cos A + b cos B))
methods.quote: $= \sin\left(C - A.\mathrm{tg}.\,\frac{a\sin A + b\sin B}{a\cos A + b\cos B}\right) \times$

methods.what: Amplitude of the combined sinusoid (law-of-cosines form)
Quadrant rule: with the root taken positive, the angle lies in 270°–90° if a cos A + b cos B is positive, and in 90°–270° if it is negative
methods.quote: $\left.\begin{matrix}0 \text{ et } 90\\ 270 \text{ et } 0\end{matrix}\right\}$ si $a\cos A + b\cos B$ est pos.
